verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's architecture docs state VM-based isolation with each sandbox running in its own VM, and the overview promises strong security boundaries for running untrusted code. That is a documented hard isolation boundary, but it rests on a single short line and the docs elsewhere describe the unit as an 'isolated container'. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the VM/hypervisor technology and threat model, explicit description of the boundary between sandboxes and the customer's own systems/bindings, consistent VM-vs-container terminology, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems

citations.quote: VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment, providing strong security boundaries while maintaining performance.
The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
